sourceContext.originPage: Grand Design RV travel trailers category page

visualCharacteristics.layout: one full-width card per row, thin rules between cards; stats in two columns; three CTAs in a row on desktop

contentPattern.structure: per card row: cell 1 product image | cell 2 model logo image, stat paragraphs (label + value), heading, description paragraphs, CTA links each in its own paragraph

suitableFor: RV model lineups on category pages (travel trailers, fifth wheels, toy haulers)
full-width product entries with logo, image, key stats, copy and several CTAs
notSuitableFor: compact icon or category tiles (use cards-category or cards-callouts)
